import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title, max_length=50):
    """URL slug for a title: ASCII, lowercase, words joined by single
    hyphens, no leading or trailing hyphen, at most max_length characters
    and never ending in a hyphen. A title with no usable characters raises
    ValueError."""
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9]+", "-", text).strip("-").lower()
    if not text:
        raise ValueError("title has no usable characters")
    return text[:max_length].rstrip("-")
